$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$taskRoot = 'C:/src/quantick-worktrees/ci-edit-loop-windows'
$binary = 'C:/src/quantick-worktrees/fix-mutation-retry-truth/target/debug/deps/quantick_app-bdab7f0be3d8e6fd.exe'
$expectedBinaryHash = 'A2D7AADF0E084D66FE5343EABBE4E7C47DC8FE5B6A59D1647297C62CCAE45053'
$pointerTest = 'app::tests::profile_pointer_tests::precise_profile_locked_selection_leaves_hidden_handle_space_to_the_chart'
$hookTest = 'app::tests::drawings_tests::the_inspector_hook_survives_the_demo_that_runs_before_it'
Set-Location -LiteralPath $taskRoot
"DIAGNOSIS_START_UTC=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
"WRAPPER_PID=$PID"
"HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
"INDEX_TREE=$(git write-tree)"
"BINARY=$binary"
"ENV_SCOPE=This PowerShell process and its fresh test children only; no global environment or configuration writes"
"INHERITED_INSPECTOR_PRESENT=$(Test-Path Env:QUANTICK_DRAWING_INSPECTOR)"
$env:QUANTICK_BUBBLES = "$taskRoot/crates/app/config/bubbles.toml"
"ENV_QUANTICK_BUBBLES=$env:QUANTICK_BUBBLES"
"BUBBLES_SHA256=$((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $env:QUANTICK_BUBBLES).Hash)"
"CARGO_LOCK_SHA256=$((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath Cargo.lock).Hash)"
function Invoke-Diagnostic([string]$Label, [string[]]$TestArguments) {
    $actualHash = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $binary).Hash
    if ($actualHash -ne $expectedBinaryHash) { throw 'Read-only diagnostic binary identity changed' }
    "RUN=$Label"
    "BINARY_SHA256=$actualHash"
    "START_UTC=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
    "COMMAND=& '$binary' $($TestArguments -join ' ')"
    & $binary @TestArguments
    $script:diagnosticExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    "TEST_EXIT_CODE=$script:diagnosticExit"
    "END_UTC=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
}
$env:QUANTICK_DRAWING_INSPECTOR = '1'
'ENV_DELTA=QUANTICK_DRAWING_INSPECTOR=1 in fresh exact-test child'
Invoke-Diagnostic 'exact-with-inspector' @($pointerTest, '--exact', '--nocapture', '--test-threads=1')
$exactExit = $script:diagnosticExit
Remove-Item Env:QUANTICK_DRAWING_INSPECTOR
'ENV_DELTA=QUANTICK_DRAWING_INSPECTOR absent in each fresh pair child'
$pairAttempts = 0
$pairFailure = $false
for ($attempt = 1; $attempt -le 20; $attempt++) {
    Invoke-Diagnostic "pair-$attempt-of-20" @($hookTest, $pointerTest, '--nocapture', '--test-threads=2')
    $pairAttempts = $attempt
    if ($script:diagnosticExit -ne 0) {
        $pairFailure = $true
        'PAIR_STOP_REASON=First failing fresh-process pair; no further attempts'
        break
    }
}
"EXACT_WITH_INSPECTOR_EXIT=$exactExit"
"PAIR_ATTEMPTS=$pairAttempts"
"PAIR_FAILURE_OBSERVED=$pairFailure"
"DIAGNOSIS_END_UTC=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
'ACCEPTANCE_STATUS=Original full workspace loop remains FAIL; this is diagnostic evidence only'
exit 0
